item.title: 英飞凌卫星雷达ART架构，能去掉MCU核吗？
One super sensor from many
item.description: Nature Photonics, Published online: 30 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01994-0 By combining 48 parallel sensors with diffractive multiplexing to recover information from the gaps between the sensors, a new wide-field microscope achieves a spatial resolution of approximately 3 micrometres over more than 5.2 square centimetres at 120 frames per second, substantially relaxing the conventional trade-off between field of view, resolution and imaging speed.

item.title: Allegro MicroSystems 携新型 XtremeSense TMR 电流传感器亮相慕尼黑上海电子展
item.description: 全球领先的运动控制、节能系统电源及传感解决方案供应商 Allegro MicroSystems, Inc.（Allegro）于 4 月 15 日亮相 2025 年慕尼黑上海电子展，以创新赋能，使命驱动，携手Allegro共创未来为主题，展示了最新推出的XtremeSenseTMR 电流传感器芯片 CT4022 和 CT4032，这两款产品能够为高压、功率密集型清洁能源应用提供卓越的噪声免疫性能和高精度电流测量能力。

item.title: Global-shutter sensor raises pixel density
item.description: At 2.2 µm, Omnivision’s OG05D 5-Mpixel image sensor offers one of the smallest global-shutter pixel sizes with HDR in its class. The post Global-shutter sensor raises pixel density appeared first on EDN .
